summary.text: Kip Capley is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 71, which covers Wayne County and parts of Hardin, Lawrence and Maury counties, who lives in Summertown, took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Capley earned a B.S. in political science and history from Middle Tennessee State University and an M.B.A. in healthcare management from Trevecca Nazarene University, graduating cum laude.
The legislature's biography lists him as a business development coordinator, and Ballotpedia describes his career experience as consulting.
He has coached youth football and basketball in Summertown.
Capley has been a member of the House since the 113th General Assembly and serves on the Finance, Ways, and Means Committee, the Health Committee and the Private Acts Committee.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Democrat Matt Day in the general election.
